description: Question about cascade and prowess interaction. Keyword tokens trigger supplemental retrieval of cascade (702.85) and prowess (702.108) rules outside the curated manifest.

request.question: When I cascade into a noncreature spell, does prowess trigger on my creature before or after the cascaded spell resolves?
